Installation

The ledger is the work queue, and every unit in it carries the status that decides whether a run picks it up again. That single rule is what keeps an interrupted run recoverable without any bookkeeping outside the ledger itself.

pip install llama-cpp-python

from llama_cpp import Llama
llm = Llama(model_path="model.gguf")
